title: Shopify vs WooCommerce
description: Compare Shopify and WooCommerce for storefront setup, catalog management, checkout, payments, extensions, hosting responsibilities, and total cost. Choose based on your team's technical capacity and business workflow, not an unsupported universal ranking.

verdict: There is no verified universal winner. Shopify is a hosted commerce platform with much of the core storefront infrastructure managed for you; WooCommerce adds commerce capabilities to a WordPress site, so hosting, plugin selection, updates, and maintenance responsibilities depend more on your setup. Those operating-model differences are a starting point, not a complete recommendation. Test your actual catalog, checkout, shipping, tax, payment, integration, and export needs, then compare total cost and who will maintain the store. Verify current product and plan details with each vendor before buying.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Shopify and WooCommerce?
faqs.answer: Shopify provides a hosted commerce platform, while WooCommerce adds ecommerce functionality to WordPress. The practical difference is how much infrastructure and maintenance your team wants to manage, plus the customization and integrations your store requires.

faqs.question: Which platform costs less?
faqs.answer: There is no reliable single price comparison for every store. Include subscription or hosting, payment processing, themes, extensions, development, maintenance, and the time needed to run the store. Confirm current prices and fees for your country and expected order volume.

faqs.question: Which is better for a store with many products?
faqs.answer: Test a realistic catalog with variants, inventory rules, bulk updates, search, and the integrations you need. Verify current plan or extension limits and measure how much effort routine catalog maintenance requires before deciding.

faqs.question: Can I migrate between Shopify and WooCommerce?
faqs.answer: Migration is possible, but products, customers, orders, URLs, subscriptions, reviews, and app-specific data may not transfer identically. Inventory what must be retained, test exports and imports, map redirects, and validate a sample before moving the live store.

faqs.question: How should I choose between them?
faqs.answer: Choose based on your required storefront workflow, technical resources, customization, payment and shipping needs, integrations, and total operating cost. Run a pilot with the same representative products and checkout scenarios, and confirm current limitations directly with the vendors.
